seo_title: Rooftop Solar Leads in Gurgaon: Sources and Lead Scoring
description: Rooftop solar leads in Gurgaon: where Gurugram enquiries come from, a simple lead score that flags qualified homeowners, and how to compete with national brands.
headline: Rooftop solar leads in Gurgaon: where they come from and how to score them
card_text: Where Gurugram rooftop solar enquiries really come from, a 10-point lead score your sales team can use on the first call, and how local installers compete with national brands.
intro:
Rooftop solar leads in Gurgaon are not hard to find. Gurugram has been one of Haryana's busiest cities for rooftop solar: state officials reported 7,497 applications from the city in the first five months of PM Surya Ghar, and more than 4,200 systems running by mid-2026. The hard part is that every installer, every national brand and every lead vendor is chasing the same homeowners, so a lot of the enquiries you pay for will never turn into a site survey.

This guide is for installers and EPCs selling rooftop solar in Gurugram. It breaks down where Gurugram enquiries actually come from, gives you a 10-point lead score your team can fill in on the first call, and explains how a local installer can win against brands with big ad budgets. If you want the wider picture of who buys solar in the city, read our earlier guide on solar marketing in Gurgaon first; this one goes deeper on the leads themselves.

sections.h2: Where rooftop solar leads in Gurgaon come from
sections.html:
Most Gurugram installers get enquiries from six places. They differ a lot in intent, cost and how much filtering they need:

SourceIntentWhat to watch
Google Search ads ("rooftop solar Gurgaon", "solar panel installation Gurugram")High: they are already comparing quotesExpensive clicks, because national brands bid on the same terms. Tight location targeting and negative keywords for jobs, dealership and training searches are essential.
Google Maps and your Business ProfileHighRanked mostly on distance, relevance and reviews. A profile with recent Gurugram project photos and reviews often beats a bigger brand that has no local presence.
Meta lead ads (Facebook and Instagram)Medium: many are curious, not readyCheapest volume, most filtering. Qualifying questions on the form decide whether the leads are usable.
Click-to-WhatsApp adsMedium to highPeople share bills and roof photos in the chat, which makes scoring easy, but someone has to reply within minutes.
Referrals and society groupsVery highSmall numbers but the best close rate. One good install in a society or block often brings the neighbours.
Bought leads from lead vendorsUnknownOften sold to several installers at once, so the homeowner gets four calls in an hour. Treat them as a test, never as your main pipeline.

Tag every lead with its source from day one. Without that, you can't tell which rupee brought the installs and which only brought phone calls.

sections.h2: Competing with national solar brands in Gurugram
sections.html:
Search for rooftop solar in Gurugram and the top results are mostly large national brands with city pages, thousands of reviews and offers like zero down payment with EMI. A local installer won't outspend them, so don't try to win on the same message. Win on what they can't easily claim:

  • Local proof. Show installs in named sectors and colonies (with the owner's permission): a kothi in DLF Phase 3, a builder floor in Palam Vihar, a villa in Sohna Road. "We've done rooftops in your sector" is more persuasive than an all-India number.
  • Who turns up. Put the faces of your survey engineer and installation team in your ads and on your website. Homeowners worry about who will be on their roof.
  • Speed. Offer a site survey within 24 or 48 hours in the sectors you cover, and only if you can keep that promise.
  • After-sales nearby. A Gurugram service number and a clear cleaning and maintenance plan answer the question every homeowner asks: what happens in year three?

On Google Ads, spend on exact and phrase match keywords with "Gurgaon", "Gurugram" and sector names rather than broad "solar panel" terms where the big brands soak up the clicks. Your website and Business Profile should use both spellings of the city naturally.

sections.h2: A 10-point score for Gurugram solar leads
sections.html:
Ask your sales team to score every new lead on the first call or WhatsApp chat. It takes two minutes and tells you who gets a site survey today, who gets a follow-up and who gets a polite no.

QuestionPoints
Owns the property (not a tenant)2
Has a usable roof: independent house, villa, or a builder floor with roof rights or other owners' agreement2
Property is in a sector or pincode your team covers1
Average monthly electricity bill fits a 3 kW or larger system (judge from their DHBVN bill)2
Has shared a recent bill or roof photo1
Wants to install within three months1
Has a clear payment plan (own funds, or a loan they are likely to get)1

A score of 8 to 10 gets a site survey booked on the call. A score of 5 to 7 gets a WhatsApp follow-up with a sample quote and a case study from a nearby sector. Below 5, thank them and close the lead, or move it to a monthly nurture list. Tenants and flat owners in societies without a roof decision usually land here, and that's fine; they are not your buyers yet.

Review the scores weekly by source. If one ad set keeps producing 3s and 4s, change its targeting or form questions before you add budget.

sections.h2: The finance question most Gurugram lead forms skip
sections.html:
Many homeowners plan to pay for rooftop solar with a loan, and that has been a real bottleneck in Haryana. In a state review in mid-2026, officials said consumers were struggling to get loans for 2 kW and 3 kW systems because of strict credit score requirements, heavy paperwork and slow processing, and asked banks to simplify the process. DHBVN, which serves Gurugram, had released around 36,000 rooftop connections against a target of 1.22 lakh at that point.

For your leads, this means a homeowner who says yes on the call may still stall for weeks at the bank. Two simple fixes:

  1. Ask how they plan to pay on the lead form or in the first chat: own funds, bank loan, or not sure yet.
  2. Make finance a step in your follow-up. If you work with a bank or NBFC, explain the documents they will need before the survey, not after the quote. A loan-ready lead is worth far more than a cheap one that stalls.

Concessional loan rates under PM Surya Ghar are linked to the repo rate and change over time, so check the current rate before you mention a number in an ad or a quote.

sections.h2: Get the subsidy and DHBVN details right in every lead conversation
sections.html:
Gurugram homeowners compare quotes from several installers, and a wrong subsidy figure is the fastest way to lose trust. Keep these points accurate:

  • Central subsidy: PM Surya Ghar gives eligible households central financial assistance of up to ₹78,000 for a system of 3 kW or more, paid to the consumer's bank account after the installation is approved. The amounts can change, so check pmsuryaghar.gov.in before each campaign.
  • State support: Haryana's extra state assistance is aimed at Antyodaya (economically weaker) families, not most Gurugram kothi and villa owners. Don't put a combined "central + state" figure in ads aimed at the whole city.
  • Approvals: the national scheme has brought in deemed approval and waived feasibility checks for residential systems up to 10 kW, and many states have dropped application and net-metering charges. Check DHBVN's current process and charges before you promise a timeline.

Our guide to writing PM Surya Ghar subsidy ads covers safe wording for headlines and lead forms.

sections.h2: What a qualified Gurugram lead looks like by the time you call
sections.html:
The best Gurugram leads arrive with most of the score already filled in. Build your forms and chats to collect it:

  1. Lead form or chat: ownership, property type, sector or pincode, average monthly bill, how they plan to pay, and when they want to install.
  2. Instant WhatsApp reply: thank them, ask for a photo of the latest DHBVN bill and the roof, and share one short video of a nearby install.
  3. Call within minutes: confirm the answers, fill in the score and book the survey for leads scoring 8 or more.
  4. Survey confirmation: send the engineer's name, time and what to keep ready (bill, roof access, sanctioned load).

Lead forms with more questions bring fewer leads, but in Gurugram traffic every wasted survey costs your team half a day. Fewer, better leads usually work out cheaper per installation.

Count leads, but judge the campaign on these instead:

  • Share of leads scoring 8 or more, by source
  • Cost per qualified lead and cost per site survey
  • Time to first call
  • Survey-to-quote and quote-to-install rates, by sector
  • Leads stuck at finance, and for how long

For reference, our rooftop solar campaigns run at ₹60–80 per qualified enquiry when they're working well, and solar clients at scale typically get 20–30 leads a day and 5–10 site visits a week. Your numbers will depend on your sectors, offer and follow-up, and nobody can promise them in advance. As a solar marketing agency working with 30+ solar EPCs and manufacturers, we run a 90-day sprint first, then a flexible arrangement. You can see the kind of work we do in our solar portfolio, and our guide on how to get solar leads in Delhi NCR covers the rest of the region.

faqs: How do I get rooftop solar leads in Gurgaon?

Combine Google Search ads and a strong Google Business Profile for high-intent homeowners with Meta or click-to-WhatsApp ads for volume. Target the sectors your team can reach, ask qualifying questions on the form and call every lead within minutes.
Are bought solar leads worth it in Gurugram?

They can work as a small test, but many vendors sell the same lead to several installers, so the homeowner gets multiple calls. Leads from your own ads and Business Profile are usually easier to convert and you can track where they came from.
What makes a rooftop solar lead qualified?

The person owns the property, has a usable roof, lives in your service area, has a bill large enough for a 3 kW or bigger system, plans to install soon and knows how they will pay. A simple point score on the first call helps your team decide quickly.
Which DISCOM handles rooftop solar in Gurugram?
Gurugram is served by Dakshin Haryana Bijli Vitran Nigam (DHBVN). Net-metering and connection steps go through DHBVN, so check its current process before you explain timelines to customers.
How much does a rooftop solar lead cost in Gurgaon?

It depends on the channel, your targeting and how competitive the keywords are. Our rooftop campaigns run at ₹60–80 per qualified enquiry when they're working well, but judge your own campaigns on cost per site survey, not cost per lead.
